title: Range dots
description: One row per item on a shared scale from zero: its values as needle dots with the run between lowest and highest as a track band, the selection's own figure as a warm bar carved clear of the dots, the earlier figure as a bloom ring, and the figure written at the row's end. Muted dots take the out-of-bounds hue.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="range-dots", role="img", the summary and data-focus; draws one SVG of the rows' height plus the axis.
A group per item: an invisible hit rect over the row, the label, the masked band, dots and prior ring, the mark bar and the figure; data-focused on the focused one.
The selection's figure as a 4px bar across the row, heartwood-300 edged in sunflower-bold; its halo in the mask cuts the surface around it.

usage: values are the individual observations (a game's figure each); mark is the selection's aggregate and prior the earlier one's, each nullable.
Name the ring with priorLabel so the summary reads 'last season 3.2' rather than 'before'.
Rows share one scale from zero, so a row's position is comparable with the rows above and below it.
Keep hover in the caller: onHover reports the row's id or null, focus holds one row full while the others step back.
